title_en: Visions of the Future (11/20): The Optimism of the Atomic Age
note_en: 太…以至于… means "so… that…": 太 marks the extreme degree and 以至于 introduces the consequence, as in 这种想象当时太流行了，以至于出现了一个叫“原子”的卡通形象 "this fantasy was so popular that a cartoon character called 'Atom' appeared." Unlike English "so… that," the two halves are usually separated by a comma, and 以至于 is formal; in speech you would more often hear 太…了，所以…
